title: What 2,000 Exposed Vibe-Coded Apps Reveal About the Limits of Most Security Stacks
summary: Shadow AI used to mean employees pasting things they shouldn't into ChatGPT. It now means something bigger: employees building full applications with AI, wiring them into production systems, and publishing them on the open internet. Without Security or IT in the loop.

title: Malicious Sicoob NuGet Steals Banking Credentials as npm Packages Target Cloud Secrets
